page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled, providing predictable compute performance across all 32 vCPUs.

The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

This hardware profile is designed for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and a lower memory-to-CPU ratio. Suitable applications include batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-heavy enterprise applications where predictable CPU execution is prioritized over large memory footprints.
